titles.romaji: Pili Yingxiong Zhan Ji: Dao Shuo Yi Shu
titles.native: 霹靂英雄戰紀之刀說異數

description:
A remake of the sixth Pili Puppet Drama season, "Strange Days". Serves as a separate continuity rebooted offshoot of the main Pili Puppet Drama series, which is still ongoing since the 80s.

As turmoil looms in the Martial World, and the Eight Wonders of the Evil Dragon unleashes dark forces, who will emerge as the new warrior legend?

(Source: Netflix)
